current_concerns.primary_problems: Mood drops every winter with oversleeping and carbohydrate cravings; present pattern for about six years and currently in the fourth month.
current_concerns.goals: Get through a winter without losing four months of her life.

past_psychiatric_history.assessment_details: Assessed by family doctor in 2021 for recurring winter low mood.
past_psychiatric_history.previous_diagnoses: Major depressive disorder with seasonal pattern.
past_psychiatric_history.previous_treatments: Bright light therapy at home during winter, starting in 2022.

medications.past_medication_details: Fluoxetine 20 mg daily for about 5 months in 2021; stopped when spring came; no remembered side effects. Bupropion 150 mg daily for about 6 months in 2023; stopped because it caused insomnia.

family_psychiatric_history.family_psychiatric_history_details: Mother had seasonal low mood and was never formally treated; no other known family psychiatric history.

substance_use.nonmedical_alcohol_use: Usually wine on weekends, about two glasses.

education_employment_legal_history.employment_history: Landscape architect at Greenline Design since 2013.

personal_history.early_childhood: Born in Oslo and moved to Toronto at age 11; had a pretty outdoorsy childhood.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: School and architecture degree went smoothly; nothing major reported.
personal_history.significant_relationships: Married for about 8 years; no children.
personal_history.future_goals: Keep working through the winter months without losing ground.
